description: Read the followers of a page your connected account administers, each joined to their full profile (headline, location, current company and title, experience, education, skills), FRESH at request time. Costs $0.003 per follower returned with its profile; the list, a follower with no public profile, a profile not found and a skipped follower are free. Up to 20 followers a page (page on with `cursor`); each follower's `enrichment.status` is ok, no_reference, not_found or skipped (with a reason: not_held, pool_busy, time_budget, unavailable). Give `page`, or the `cursor` of the previous page. Requires a connected account. Allow at least 45 seconds. While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged.

count.description: Followers per page, 1 to 20 (default 20); page on with `cursor`.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page.

name: page_followers_enriched
